description: Converts a value between units in one category: length, weight, temperature, volume, or speed. Returns the converted result in the page's display precision, the value in base units, and the conversion rate (null for temperature, which uses an offset scale). Unit codes must belong to the chosen category. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive unit converter calculator.

from_unit.description: Unit code to convert from. Must be a unit of the chosen category: length m, km, cm, mi, ft, in; weight kg, g, lb, oz; temperature C, F, K; volume L, mL, gal, floz; speed ms, kmh, mph.

to_unit.description: Unit code to convert to. Must be a unit of the chosen category, using the same code lists as from_unit.

name: calculate_unit_converter
